soldier: Head of the soldier deep yellowish brown. Head capsule oval-rectangular, the fontanelle projecting like a small hillock. Antennae 13–14 segments, the first slightly larger than the third, and the third about three times the second. Compound eyes very slightly projecting. Labrum semicircular. Apex of the mandibles rather straight and pointed, the basal prominence moderate; the left mandible about 0.66 of the head capsule and about equal in length to the head width. Lacinia of the maxilla with ten marginal hairs. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad V-shaped concavity, the posterior margin running in a straight line, median emargination index 12–19%, more than 30 hairs in the middle region, the median line distinct. Hind femur 2.4–2.6 times as long as wide.
